summary: Local constancy of the correlations near each point and the openness of L make the kernel locally constant.

steps.claim: It suffices that topKernel is eventually constant near each (p, q):
steps.lean:
.of_at fun x ↦ tendsto_const_nhds.congr' (by
  have A p := (Continuous.prodMk_left 1).continuousAt (eventually_correlation_eq Z p)
  filter_upwards [prod_mem_nhds (A _) (A _), (L.2.preimage_of_continuous (f :=
    ((x.1 𝔰.ϱ).1 - ·.1 𝔰.ϱ))).mem_nhds (by simp)] with _ a (d : _ ∈ L)
  simpa [uncurry, topKernel, ← add_mem_cancel_right (y := _ - _) d] using
    integral_congr_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae (ae_stackMeasure_mem.mono (by simp_all))))

steps.claim: correlations are locally constant in p (eventually_correlation_eq at l' = 1);
near (p, q) both correlations agree and the domain condition is unchanged (L open subgroup);
steps.lean:
filter_upwards [prod_mem_nhds (A _) (A _), (L.2.preimage_of_continuous (f :=
    ((x.1 𝔰.ϱ).1 - ·.1 𝔰.ϱ))).mem_nhds (by simp)] with _ a (d : _ ∈ L)

simpa [uncurry, topKernel, ← add_mem_cancel_right (y := _ - _) d] using
    integral_congr_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae (ae_stackMeasure_mem.mono (by simp_all))))
